messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Solstice Labs renewal in 10 days. They want a 9-month contract, 40 seats, and SSO. Procurement says PO + delegated signer required. Can we align on pricing and sign path?
Liam AE: They asked for 10% off. I can go to 7% if legal confirms signer evidence and ops confirms PO flow.
Jordan Ops: PO process ok. Need billing entity (US vs EU) and whether they want monthly invoice or single upfront. Vendor code available on request.
Priya Legal: For delegated signer we need an approval email from CFO and a screenshot of the signer in their corporate directory. Also check if they want any contract amendments.
Maya (CS): Customer prefers standard T&Cs, but requests data residency note for EU customers. I asked procurement to send CFO approval + PO template.
Liam AE: Offer: 9mo @ 7% if they sign within 48h, otherwise standard renewal price.
Jordan Ops: Draft invoice attached below. Please confirm seat count and billing cadence.
```
Invoice draft:
Customer: Solstice Labs
Term: 9 months
Seats: 40
List price (prorated): $108,000
Discount: 7% -> $100,440
Billing: Net30, single invoice
PO: pending (they'll upload)
Line items: seats, SSO, onboarding credit
```
Maya (CS): Seat count confirmed at 40. Procurement uploaded PO template and requested separate line items.
Priya Legal: Once CFO email arrives save to contract folder and add note referencing delegated signer. No contract edits requested beyond residency line.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created env_SL0X. Recipient: signer@solstice.com. Status: sent.
Liam AE: Sent with 7% concession and residency clause. Maya please confirm clause text present.
Maya (CS): Confirmed clause: "Customer data for EU accounts will be stored within EU regions unless otherwise agreed."
Jordan Ops: Vendor code VND-9427 created. Billing ready to accept PO when uploaded.
Maya (CS): Signed via DocuSign at 2024-07-02T11:05Z (env_SL0X). CFO approval email forwarded to legal.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env_SL0X status: completed. Signed at 2024-07-02T11:05Z.
Jordan Ops: PO uploaded PO-SOL-882 referencing VND-9427. Invoice issued for $100,440 net30.
Liam AE: Marked renewal closed in CRM: 9mo, 40 seats, 7% discount.
Priya Legal: Contract artifacts saved, delegated signer evidence stored. No further blockers.
Maya (CS): Onboarding kickoff scheduled for Tue 9am PT. Closing thread :white_check_mark:
